title: The medicine show troupe and the two doctors
summary: Lewis names his troupe (Willie Pope, Jim Jackson, Little Bob) and describes the two doctors, Richard Lewis and Dr. Fuller, selling medicine from a big van.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: A fella named Willie Pope, Jim Jackson. No Jim Jackson was put out and moved to Kansas City. Yeah. Willie Pope, Jim Jackson and a fella called Little Bob. Who's Willie Pope? What's he play? Oh he was a dancer. Little Bob? Buck dancing. Little Bob. He played a fiddle.
And anybody else? No. One of the four of us. Did you have a doctor? Oh yeah. A doctor that

sellin' that medicine. Two of them. See we travel around in a big van. Oh yeah. Two doctors. They sellin' Jackatone medicine. Corn medicine and different stuff like that. I mean they sell it to you. Buy one bottle like that. You get one bottle free. The bottle costs you a dollar. Mmhmm. Anyway. They sell a minute bottle of that medicine.
Let me move over here where Jack was sittin'. I think it'll pick me up better. Okay you can check it out. But uh what was the doctor's name?

One was named Lewis like I am. Mmhmm. Richard Lewis. And the other doctors called him Dr. Fuller. Mmhmm. That's what we ever know. Dr. Fuller. One was named Richard Lewis. Now they was kind of young doctors. They were old doctors. They were young. What would they tell the people? Well they just go and tell them what that medicine would do. You know it's like you tell them like it's good for rheumatism or cramp. You know a headache or different things. Well it was good medicine. Now they wouldn't be tellin' no story cause uh people would buy it and we'd go to a place. You know we'd stay there sometime two weeks and people would buy it and they'd show come back to get more. It done what they said. It was good medicine alright.
You took it out? Did I take any of it?
Mmhmm. No cause I never was sick. Oh. I never take none. I drank too much whiskey. I stayed well. Mmhmm. Alright. It was good medicine though.
